name: UWC Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减或合约动态，主要公告为季度业绩、股本发行与公司秘书变更。全年营收由2025财年的386,175,000 MYR增至594,892,000 MYR，净利润由40,510,000 MYR增至93,837,000 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or contract developments for its business segments in its announcements; the main announcements were quarterly results, equity issuances, and a change of company secretary. Full-year revenue increased from MYR 386,175,000 in FY2025 to MYR 594,892,000 in FY2026, while net profit rose from MYR 40,510,000 to MYR 93,837,000.
